parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the ID of the container cluster.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name of the namespace to which the repository belongs.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-image-risk --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --cluster-id c80f79959fd724a888e1187779b130000 --namespace kube-sy0000 --app-name e0000 --image-name container-000:0000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListImageRisk --region cn-hangzhou --ImageName 'container-000:0000' --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --ClusterId c80f79959fd724a888e1187779b130000 --Namespace 'kube-sy0000' --AppName e0000
